title: KeyManagerMoveItemRef

kind.description: What holds a stored value Move can take: forge-account (a forge account's pasted token), endpoint (a webhook endpoint's pasted secret) or bank (a bank's fallback token).

id.description: The item's id with its owner: a forge account's or bank's id, or a webhook endpoint's name.

description: An item Move takes, by its kind and its owner's id for it.
